description: US domestic Fedwire transfer. Demonstrates a high-value, same-day USD wire transfer between US banks using Fedwire clearing system with DEBT charge bearer (debtor pays all charges).
test_coverage: Fedwire clearing system (US real-time gross settlement)
USD currency with high value amount (150,000 USD)
High priority instruction (HIGH vs normal NORM)
DEBT charge bearer (debtor/ordering customer pays all charges)
US state codes in addresses (CA, NY)
Fedwire-specific service level and local instrument codes
business_rules_expected_to_pass: PACS008-AM02: Currency decimal places valid (USD has 2 decimals)
PACS008-DT01: Settlement date not in past
PACS008-DT02: Settlement date not more than 90 days in future
notes: This message is semantically equivalent to the usd_wire.mt MT103 test case. Fedwire is the US Federal Reserve's real-time gross settlement system. Unlike SEPA, US domestic transfers typically do not use IBANs, and DEBT charge bearer is common (debtor pays all fees). Same-day settlement is typical for Fedwire transfers. High priority ensures fastest processing.
